title: Help with differences
hint: The assistant gathers the PO, the goods received and the prices by the system's rules, then shows the ways you can settle each difference. It changes nothing itself, and a drafted message goes only when you send it.

step.poLine: Read PO line {poLine}: ordered {ordered} {uom} at THB {price} each
step.invoiceLine: Read line {line} of this invoice: billed {invoiced} {uom} at THB {price} each
step.elsewhere: Checked other invoices of the line: they billed {quantity} {uom}
step.receipts: Read the receipts: {received} {uom} received in {count} receipts, the last on {date}
step.receiptsNone: Read the receipts: nothing of this line has been received
step.agreement: Compared the agreed price with the supplier: THB {price} each, valid before {date}
step.agreementNone: Compared the agreed price: the supplier has none on the invoice's date
step.agreementNoItem: Compared the agreed price: the line is not a catalogue item, so there is none
step.pastPrices: Compared past prices: bought {count} times in {days} days, last at THB {price} each on {po}, {date}
step.pastPricesWithVat: Compared past prices: bought {count} times in {days} days, last at THB {price} each with VAT on {po}, {date}
step.pastPricesNone: Compared past prices: not bought in the last {days} days
step.vatStated: Read the VAT on the invoice: THB {stated}
step.fixesNone: Looked for ways: none you can take yourself; the difference is sent to {role}
step.drafts: Drafted a message for you to read, change and send yourself
step.choose: Waiting for you to choose a way

fix.VARIANCE: Ask for a price variance approval under the DOA
fix.PO_CHANGE: Change the PO with a PO change; the match runs again by itself
fix.RECEIVE: Receive the rest; the match runs again by itself
fix.ASK: Ask the receiver or the requester
fix.EMAIL_SUPPLIER: Ask the supplier for a credit note or a new invoice
fix.RECHECK: Check again once the cause is fixed
fix.DISMISS_DUPLICATE: Dismiss the warning if it is not a duplicate
fix.REOPEN: Reopen as a draft if it was entered wrongly
fix.REJECT: Reject the invoice when the supplier sends a new one
fix.REJECT_DUPLICATE: Reject the invoice if it really is a duplicate
fix.BUDGET_TRANSFER: Ask for a budget transfer, then check again

ask.title: Draft a question to the receiver or the requester
ask.hint: The recipient reads the whole message in BCS; LINE and e-mail carry the invoice and PO numbers only
ask.confirmHint: It goes in your name and the invoice's history records that you sent it

email.title: Draft an e-mail to the supplier
email.noEmail: The supplier has no e-mail address yet. Tell them another way, or ask procurement to add one
email.hint: The e-mail carries the invoice and PO numbers and your name as the contact
email.confirmHint: It goes in the organization's name with you as the contact, and the invoice's history records that you sent it. It cannot be taken back
email.send: Send the e-mail to the supplier
email.sent: E-mail to the supplier sent; it goes out within a few minutes

empty: The message is empty. Write it before sending
tooLong: The message is longer than {max} characters

errors.RECIPIENT_NOT_ALLOWED: This person is no longer a receiver or requester of the line. Open the page again and choose again
errors.SUPPLIER_NOT_ALLOWED: Finance e-mails the supplier, or procurement about the differences sent to procurement
errors.SUPPLIER_NO_EMAIL: The supplier has no e-mail address yet
errors.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: The difference was settled or changed. Open the page again to see where it stands

ask.PRICE_OVER: Dear {name}, line {line} ({description}) of invoice {invoice} on PO {po} is billed at THB {price} each, above the PO price of THB {poPrice}. Was a new price agreed with the supplier? Thank you
ask.QTY_OVER_ORDERED: Dear {name}, line {line} ({description}) of invoice {invoice} on PO {po} bills {invoiced} {uom}, more than the {ordered} {uom} ordered. Was more ordered from the supplier? Thank you
ask.QTY_NOT_RECEIVED: Dear {name}, line {line} ({description}) of invoice {invoice} on PO {po} bills {invoiced} {uom}, but {received} {uom} have been received{elsewhere}. Has everything on the invoice arrived? If so, please record the receipt in BCS. Thank you
ask.ACCEPTANCE_PENDING: Dear {name}, service line {line} ({description}) of invoice {invoice} on PO {po} bills {invoiced} {uom}, but {received} {uom} have been accepted{elsewhere}. Is the work on the invoice done? If so, please confirm it in BCS. Thank you

email.PRICE_OVER: Your invoice {supplierInvoiceNo} on our purchase order {po} bills {description} at THB {price} each, which does not match the order's THB {poPrice}. Please send a credit note, or a new invoice at the ordered price
email.QTY_OVER_ORDERED: Your invoice {supplierInvoiceNo} on our purchase order {po} bills {invoiced} {uom} of {description}, more than the {ordered} {uom} ordered. Please send a credit note, or a new invoice for the ordered quantity
email.QTY_NOT_RECEIVED: Your invoice {supplierInvoiceNo} on our purchase order {po} bills {invoiced} {uom} of {description}, but we have received {received} {uom}. Please tell us when the rest arrives, or send a new invoice for what was delivered
email.ACCEPTANCE_PENDING: Your invoice {supplierInvoiceNo} on our purchase order {po} bills {invoiced} {uom} of {description}, but we have accepted {received} {uom}. Please tell us how the rest of the work stands, or send a new invoice for what was handed over
email.VAT_MISMATCH: Your invoice {supplierInvoiceNo} on our purchase order {po} states VAT of THB {stated}, which does not match the VAT of its amounts. Please check it and send a correct tax invoice
email.VAT_SUPPLIER_NOT_REGISTERED: Your invoice {supplierInvoiceNo} on our purchase order {po} charges VAT of THB {stated}, but our register shows you are not registered for VAT. Please check it and send a new invoice
